description.value:
Trigger You critically succeed at a Graft check to install a new augment into your own body.

Requirement bio-attuned

Duration permanent, per augment

That augment's Load cost is reduced by 1 (minimum 1) for as long as it's grafted into you.

cinderfall.incomplete: BAND-GAP (Load isn't a real item field; ItemAlteration's field list has no "load" entry) stacked on INSTALL-GRAFT-GAP (the triggering check itself isn't modeled).
